title: Oracle rises as AI-fueled backlog growth deflects spending worries
summary: Oracle shares rose 3% in early trading after a $26 billion increase in its revenue backlog eased concerns over its debt-funded AI spending. Strong earnings and an improving balance sheet also supported the stock, though analysts warned that a meaningful recovery in Oracle's cash flow could still take years.
